coverage.policy: intersection of supported holes in every sensor view

card.distance: equal mean of SWIR and TIR DTW sequence distances on the common supported-hole cohort; equal sensor weighting, no scale calibration

regrouping.naming: Original full-feature names preserved through verified equivalent partition; unsupported container is unassigned
regrouping.meaning: Only hole grouping was reevaluated with a minimum two-hole replication floor; this is not a calibrated accuracy threshold
regrouping.inherited_distance_method: equal mean of SWIR and TIR DTW sequence distances on the common supported-hole cohort; equal sensor weighting, no scale calibration

hole_clustering.k_rule: smallest K within 0.02 of best silhouette among supported candidates
hole_clustering.partition_note: descriptive partition selected by silhouette; not geological validation

support_policy.meaning: replication floor for descriptive groups; not geological validation
